name: Orphaned VMDK assessment
summary: Finds virtual disks no registered VM references, classifies them and sizes the reclaimable capacity.
description: Read-only. Builds the list of files referenced by every registered VM and template in all enabled sites (so disks of VMs in another vCenter that shares a datastore are not reported), scans each datastore once and classifies the unreferenced disks: unregistered VM, detached disk, orphaned snapshot, CBT leftover, RDM mapping file. Reports capacity by category, age and datastore, the largest items and the full inventory. Nothing is deleted.

inputs.name: AllSites
inputs.label: Include every enabled site
inputs.help: Recommended: VMs registered in the other vCenters are taken into account and their datastores are scanned too.

inputs.name: DatastoreExcludePattern
inputs.label: Skip datastores matching
inputs.help: Regular expression on datastore names, e.g. ^local-|^datastore1
